g.title: TF_WFSUBJECTS
g.text: By ticking this flag, you can choose a page to which the actor who receives this task can navigate. The level of authorization will be the same that would be applied if the user accessed this page outside the workflow or, if specified, the authorization of the Security Profile linked to the workflow role. The access control of this content is limited to show/hide settings, by stage. Use this option, for example, to link a read only page for reporting.
